title: Retaguarda
description: Web-based ERP system with electronic invoice issuance, movement control, financial management, inventory, printed reports, integration with Zebra printers and sales with integrated POS

more.overview: Retaguarda is the web version of a complete web-based ERP system, with electronic invoice issuance, movement control, financial management, inventory, printed reports, integration with Zebra printers and sales with integrated POS. This was my first major project as an intern at Qualisoft Informática and provided me with a great opportunity for learning and growth in a short period of time
features: Electronic invoice issuance
Control of product entries and exits
Inventory counting
Management of accounts payable and accounts receivable
Generation of printed reports
Integration with Zebra printers for label printing
Sales facilitated with integrated POS for desktop and mobile
Management of suppliers, customers and employees
Permission system for different levels of access and roles
Responsive and modern web interface
results: Complete Web-based ERP system for commercial management
challenges: Ensure consistency in queries to the multi-tenant database
Optimize read operations using Redis for caching frequent queries
Implement integration with the Tax Authority for electronic invoice issuance
Integrate with Zebra printers via the ZPL protocol for label printing
learnings: Multi-tenant database architecture for multiple clients
Configuration of IPs, domains and SSL certificates using Homehost and Registro.br
Deployment of system in a Linux environment using a virtual machine with Apache on AWS (Amazon EC2)
Communication with cloud database using Amazon RDS
Integration with Zebra printers via the ZPL protocol
Integration with the Tax Authority for electronic invoice issuance

title: AcquaData
description: Monitoring and management for shrimp farming farms with IoT telemetry, dashboards and analytical reports

more.overview: AcquaData was created to centralize sensor readings, tank management and report generation for shrimp producers. Devices send telemetry through MQTT, while the backend processes and stores the data in PostgreSQL.
features: User registration and authentication with JWT
Individual management of dug ponds (tanks)
Telemetry received from ESP32-C6 devices in a Zigbee network via the MQTT messaging protocol
Real-time visualization of temperature, pH, dissolved solids, turbidity and other metrics
Generation of printed reports or Excel spreadsheets by tank and time interval
Full reading history and identification of important changes
Sending important alerts via WhatsApp

images.alt: Dashboard with indicator cards and reading charts for a pond
images.description: Main dashboard used to track the current and historical measurements of each pond
features: Summary of the latest reading for each pond
Individual pond selection
Real-time information about temperature, pH, dissolved solids and turbidity

images.description: Menu to connect a WhatsApp number and receive important alerts by message
features: Integrate WhatsApp with the dashboard using a QR code
Configure minimum and maximum recommended parameters for each metric
Define rules for alert delivery

images.alt: Reports screen with period and metric filters
images.description: Generation of printed reports in PDF, Excel spreadsheets or CSV by pond and time interval
features: Filter by period.
Metric selection.
Comparison between tanks.
Information export.

images.alt: Tanks screen with a list of registered tanks
images.description: Tank management and definition of measuring devices for each pond
features: Register and edit tanks
Define the devices that provide telemetry for each tank

results: A server capable of processing dozens of simultaneous sensor readings in real time
A server capable of detecting readings outside the expected range and sending alerts via WhatsApp
A responsive web dashboard with interactive charts for real-time metric visualization
A reporting system with PDF output and data export to Excel or CSV
A project ready to evolve into a complete ERP for shrimp farms
challenges: Preparing the Zigbee network so the device works in open environments with difficult Wi-Fi access
Ensuring the hardware runs with low power consumption and can be recharged with solar energy
Creating a provisioning system so the end user can link their device to their account easily
Ensuring the server can process a large number of simultaneous readings
learnings: MQTT messaging protocol and IoT device integration
As my first Go project, I learned a lot about the language and asynchronous processing

more.overview: TorcidasPRO was created to modernize and facilitate the management of local supporters' groups in the capital of Ceará, and has expanded to serve large supporters' groups of the biggest clubs in Brazil.

Summary of the latest orders and members

images.alt: Settings menu with complete site customization
images.description: Settings menu with complete platform customization and real-time preview
features: Customize platform colors, images, features and texts
Real-time preview of changes

images.description: Complete financial control, with order management, supporter plan management, payment gateway accounts and freight integration
features: Configure payment gateways and bank accounts
Complete management of revenue and expenses
Integrate products with freight systems

images.description: Management of orders, payments and delivery status
features: View user orders
Manage deliveries and freight values

images.description: Supporter dashboard with event check-in, loyalty program and order history

Accumulate points and exchange them for rewards
Subscribe to supporter plans and check orders

results: Strengthening supporter groups of Brazil's main clubs
Several positive customer reviews regarding how easy it is to create the site

Creating an interface where any user can create their site from anywhere without technical knowledge
Managing cache and optimizing settings loading while ensuring real-time changes and low latency for the end user
learnings: Learned ways to adapt desktop interface design for mobile devices
Server-side cache management to minimize latency for the end user
Building interfaces with dynamic and fully customizable colors so any client can apply their visual identity

title: Vitrine Virtual
description: Simple e-commerce system for displaying products and services, integrated with WhatsApp for direct contact with the seller and automatic shipping cost calculation

more.overview: Vitrine Virtual is a showcase system for simple display of products and services, integrated with WhatsApp for direct contact with the seller and automatic shipping cost calculation. This project was developed as part of my internship at Qualisoft Informática, where I was able to apply my knowledge in web development and system integration.
features: Display of products and services in a fully customized page
Integration with WhatsApp for direct contact with the seller
Automatic shipping cost calculation based on postal code, distance or delivery zone
Responsive and modern web interface
Assistance in product configuration with Artificial Intelligence
results: Integration with OpenAI in the product module
learnings: Integration with external Artificial Intelligence APIs
Prototyping intelligent interfaces for desktop and mobile for simple website creation

title: LeãoFut

Athlete information, transfer history and market value
Section for squad exploration
Section for analysis with interactive charts and athlete comparisons

title: CARtográficos
description: Proposed solution for the HaCARthon hackathon focused on improvements to the CAR (Rural Environmental Registry), addressing the challenge of improving the CAR geospatial data

more.overview: The hackathon proposed by Enap aims to develop innovative solutions that contribute to strengthening the Rural Environmental Registry System (SICAR). We chose to address the challenge of improving CAR geospatial data and suggested a system for demarcating property via GPS, providing almost 100% accuracy.
